Salman Khan Defends Contestant on Bigg Boss 20, Scolds Others

On episode 36 of Bigg Boss 20, host Salman Khan addressed contestants, reprimanding Yung DSA and Scout OP for bullying fellow contestant Qazi Touqeer. Khan took a stand in support of Touqeer, who became emotional during the episode.
